integrity: An analytic proof covers all finite abelian groups and all integers 1 <= m < n. A reproducibility script performs supplementary finite numerical tests, which are not used as a substitute for proof. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact minimum and its minimizers in the nondivisible regime are not obtained; the graph application excludes balanced K_{m,m} because its two contrast eigenspaces merge. No uniform quantitative stability or algorithmic labeling result is claimed.
title: Subgroup rigidity for Fourier norms of coordinate-contrast projections
